Do: Animate enter with 150-250ms ease-out and exit slightly faster; wrap lists in AnimatePresence
Don't: Use bounce elastic or durations over 400ms on UI chrome
Code Example Good: <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2; ease: 'easeOut' }}>

Do: Use layout or layoutId for shared-element moves so the eye can track rank #1
Don't: Animate top/left/width/height (layout thrash) or skip layout animation entirely

Do: Hover and press feedback in 150ms; keep scale under 1.03 on product UI
Don't: Elastic spring on buttons or hover that moves layout
Code Example Good: <motion.button whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }} transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}>

Do: Use Auto-Animate for insert/remove/reorder on tables and filters when the package is installed
Don't: Hand-roll FLIP or bounce rows in and out
Code Example Good: useAutoAnimate() on the tbody or list parent
Code Example Bad: animate-bounce on every new table row

Do: Lenis only on marketing or long-scroll storytelling pages
Don't: Smooth-scroll hijack on app chrome dashboards or data tables
Code Example Good: Lenis on a landing page with prefers-reduced-motion disable
Code Example Bad: new Lenis() on an invoice queue

Do: Fire confetti once at a Peak-End milestone (first success) then never again on that surface
Don't: Confetti on every save click or page load
Code Example Good: confetti({ particleCount: 60; spread: 50 }) once on first invoice created
Code Example Bad: confetti() inside a useEffect with no guard

Do: Honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — opacity only or no motion
Don't: Ignore the media query or force parallax
Code Example Bad: ScrollTrigger parallax with no reduced-motion branch

Do: Never use bounce or elastic easing on menus dialogs dropdowns or tables
Don't: animate-bounce or spring bounce > 0.2 on product chrome

Do: Lottie or Rive only as Zara's single peak on onboarding or empty-state illustration
Don't: Looping Lottie on a daily dashboard
Code Example Bad: <Lottie loop autoplay /> in the app shell

Do: CSS transitions with transform and opacity are enough when Motion is not installed
Don't: Animate width height top left or box-shadow on every hover
